newsSince: Keli's force-sensing thesis improved: 2026 disclosures say robot force sensors have moved from R&D validation to small-batch delivery, samples have gone to more than 70 robot companies, 2025 sales exceeded 1,500 units, and monthly robot force-sensor shipments have passed 1,000 units. It is also investing across tactile sensing, IMU, vision and body platforms.

sources.label: Securities Daily on Keli robot sensor shipments
Keli 603662 six-axis force/torque sensor product series (moomoo)

verdicts.rankRationale: Force/torque sensing is one of the cleaner humanoid bottlenecks, and Keli now has >70 robot customers sampled plus >1,000 monthly force-sensor shipments. That converts the thesis from optionality into early scale while keeping the name more hidden than lidar and headline actuator leaders.
verdicts.bull: Differentiated 6D force/torque exposure, completed product series, deep under-ownership, no YTD froth to unwind.
verdicts.neutral: Real stack fit but commercialization is incremental; alpha already partly captured at score 76.7.
verdicts.bear: China component competition intensifies; force-sensing content per robot stays small and ASP-pressured.
verdicts.primaryCatalyst: Design-win/volume orders into a named humanoid program
verdicts.primaryRisk: Commoditization of force sensors and China price competition
